killTrigger: a16z/helios is single-org-maintained (a16z crypto), no second maintainer of record found (research §4). Ethereum hard forks (e.g. the Fusaka line, already precedented in the 0.9.x release notes) can change header/consensus format; a light client that hasn't re-synced its fork schedule fails closed (safe) or worse, silently trusts an unvalidated format. If a16z stops shipping releases across a hard-fork boundary, the sidecar feature dies — we do not fork or maintain the Rust client ourselves (that would mean linking/building the crate, which the sidecar design explicitly avoids). This is a standing precondition on the whole Helios sidecar, not a footnote.
bitcoinSupport: NONE — a16z/helios covers Ethereum, OP Stack (op-mainnet, base), and Linea only (research §6). Never extrapolate Bitcoin capability onto this pin.
platformsNotPinned: windows: a16z/helios ships no Windows binary asset for this tag (only darwin amd64/arm64 and linux amd64/arm64/armv7/riscv64gc exist) — the Helios sidecar has no Windows-host path today; unpinned. linux-armv7 / linux-riscv64gc: not a helmd build target (helm/scripts/build-sea.mjs only targets windows/macos/linux-x64/arm64-class hosts); left unpinned rather than pinning assets nothing consumes.
